issues: The passive ability is incorrectly encoded as grantOnAllyFollowerEnter; it should trigger during your turn whenever an enemy follower is destroyed and give this follower [attack]+1. Replace it with an on-enemy-follower-destroyed-style trigger limited to your turn that buffs self atk +1; this trigger timing/condition is not present in the current ability reference and should be implemented.
The passive buff should increase only [attack] by 1 when the destruction event happens, not when an ally follower enters the field.

The fanfare buffFieldTrait effect is incomplete: it should also affect Pixie followers in your EX area. Encode it as a field-and-EX-area trait buff excluding this card, but includeExArea support for buffFieldTrait is not implemented in the current engine and should be added.

The damage amount is incorrect: X should equal the number of cards named Magical Pawn on your field plus 2. Change the amount from namedIdentityFieldCount alone to a dynamic amount that adds 2 to that count.

The Aluzard buff targets are encoded incorrectly with trait: "Aluzard, Timeworn Vampire"; the card text refers to followers named Aluzard, Timeworn Vampire on your field. It should target by identity name, requiring a field buff operation/filter by card name rather than trait; such name-based field buff support should be implemented.

The conditional check is incorrect: it checks exAreaNamedMin, but the source requires 3 faceup evolved followers named Aluzard, Timeworn Vampire in your evolve deck. This needs an evolve-deck named-count condition with faceup/evolved-state support, which is not in the current engine and should be implemented.

The first damage clause should deal 1 damage to your leader and each enemy follower on the field only. dealDamageAllEnemies without followersOnly may also hit the enemy leader; it should be restricted to enemy followers.

The activated effect is encoded as dealDamageAllEnemies/includeLeaders, which damages enemy followers and leaders; the source says 'Deal 1 damage to each leader.' Replace it with damage to both leaders only, not enemy followers.

The fanfare buff amount is incorrect: X should equal the number of cards named Bloodstained Berserker in your cemetery, not on your field. Replace namedIdentityFieldCount with a cemetery name-count dynamic amount; a dynamic amount/count by identity name in cemetery is not available in the current engine and should be implemented.
